observations.contract: Road inference discards all plan errors
observations.trace: For a selected candidate, road inference increments both evaluation counters then uses let Ok(plan) = terrain.plan(a,b) else continue. TerrainPack.plan uses a default profile and no deadline; its plan loop distinguishes NoRoute from other errors and propagates non-NoRoute errors from plan_window. That path samples terrain cells with ?, and cell/chunk can return I/O or corrupt-chunk Validation errors. The inference caller nevertheless skips any Err as though the link were unavailable, and eventually updates report counts/digest and returns the world.
observations.remaining: This is a conditional source trace; no failing pack, plan, road, report, product or test ran. The no-deadline plan call does not establish a reachable Deadline error here. Actual candidate availability, surviving downstream validation and whether a particular failure changes compiled roads remain open. Original Adler337 finding q130 is reconnected, with no historical count change.

observations.trace: UnitBasisPoints stores private u16 and new permits only0..10000, but derives Deserialize with serde(transparent). Pinned serde_derive1.0.229 transparent source deserializes the underlying field and constructs the struct directly unless a field-level deserializer is supplied; this type has none. A deserializer delivering u16 10001 can therefore bypass new in this selected Serde path. Its complement subtracts the retained field from10000, which is below zero for this input; with integer overflow checks enabled that subtraction panics. The as_unit_f32 conversion exceeds1. SignedUnitBasisPoints similarly derives transparent deserialization over i16 without its ±10000 constructor bound. The investigation BasisPoints wrapper also derives Deserialize over the inner type.
observations.remaining: No macro expansion, deserialization, arithmetic operation, panic, runtime or test ran. The exact application payload route, SpacetimeDB generated/native schema admission and actual compiler profile are not established; outcome without overflow checks is not generalized. Existing checked consumers such as KnowledgeConfidence::try_new remain distinct. Original Adler337 q131 is reconnected, with no historical count change.
